transcript.text: Hello, I'm calling from Mumbai Bank. Am I speaking to Rakesh Sharma?
Yes, this is Rakesh Sharma speaking. How can I help you?

Great, thanks. I wanted to remind you that your credit card payment was due on 15th October. Your minimum amount due is 4,820 rupees. That includes interest, and a late payment fee of 750 rupees. Your total outstanding bill is 18,420 rupees.
Oh, I'm sorry about that. I completely forgot to make the payment this month. I'll make sure to pay the minimum amount by the 4th of next month. Is that okay?
Thank you for letting me know. How much will you pay on 4th November?
I will pay the full minimum amount due, which is 4,820 rupees, on the 4th of November.
